claim: The largest remaining block of zeros was not a control shape at all. It was one application, and the right unit of procedure is the app.

measurement.instrument: full 130 tasks x 5 reps, page identity per rep, exclusive CDP browser

mechanisms: ONE PROCEDURE, TEN GOALS: find the row in #main .email-thread by .email-sender, open it, then act. The action handlers are bound ONLY after the row is opened.

THE PAGE STATES ITS OWN OPERANDS: core.currentFields = {by,to} or {task,by}. The plain variants also mark them up with span.bold; the -nl variants are free text drawn from ~30 alternate phrasings with no stable surface. Reading the sentence was never necessary.
THE FORWARD BODY IS PRE-FILLED and scored against the original body exactly, so overwriting it is a certain miss.
A REFUSAL IS THE DECOMPOSER DECLINING, NOT THE PAGE FAILING: run_episode returned REFUSED before dispatch ever ran, so an app whose procedure does not depend on the sentence was being refused anyway.

regression_check.method: every DOWN task re-measured at 10 reps

phone-book.verdict: NOT a regression. The identical failure signature resolve-not_found appears at 0.20, 0.40 and 0.10 across three readings of unchanged code. This task is unstable, which is the thing the learning loop exists to fix.

honest_reading: The email result is large and repeatable (49/50 across ten tasks). The paired +8.00 pp is the honest total effect, and it is the one number in this round that clears significance on its own.
